 How ‘Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County’ star Aspyn Ovard’s ‘friends with benefits’ proposal turned into a full-fledged throuple 
 By 
 Samantha Nungesser 
 Published 
 Nov. 9, 2026, 7:17 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Aspyn Ovard’s unconventional relationship is making its small-screen debut.
 In an exclusive clip from Thursday’s forthcoming “Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County” premiere, Ovard introduces the Hulu audience to her partners, Bri and Billy Davis. 
 “Being in a throuple is something I never pictured myself doing before,” Ovard, 30, admits in the clip.

 10

 The YouTube star says she gained “a lot of perspective on life and what life is about” following her 2024 divorce from Parker Ferris , with whom she shares daughters Cove, 7, Lola, 5, and Elle, 2.
 They were together for eight years before Ovard filed for divorce.
 After their split, Ovard “wanted to date a woman,” and that’s when Bri entered the picture.
 10 
 Ovard (pictured above in “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County”) said she met Bri on Instagram about a year and a half ago. Hulu 
 10 
 Ovard (pictured above with Bri in “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County”) said their relationship started when Bri asked her to be “friends with benefits.” Hulu 
 “We met through Instagram a year and a half ago,” Ovard says in her confessional. “Our relationship basically started with her asking if I wanted to be friends with benefits.”
 “It was supposed to be casual, and then here we are; it is not casual.”
 In the clip, Ovard is seen applying lip liner to Bri, whose arms are wrapped around the content creator.
 10 
 While Ovard didn’t see herself dating men again, she said she also “clicked” with Bri’s husband Billy. (Pictured above: Bri and Billy in “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County.) Hulu 
 10 
 “Being in a throuple is something I never pictured myself doing before,” Ovard (pictured above in “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County”) said in the clip. Hulu 
 After the women share a few kisses with each other, Bri’s husband, Billy, walks into the bedroom and Ovard plants one on him, too. 
 “I swore I would never ever be with a man again, but the three of us hung out together and we just really clicked right away,” she gushes to the cameras.
 Bri and Billy first met in middle school, but they didn’t start dating until they were 15 and 16, Bri explains in a TikTok video .
 10 
 Bri and Billy (pictured above with Ovard in an Instagram post) have been together since they were teenagers. Maya Dehlin 
 10 
 Some time into their marriage, Bri (pictured above with Ovard in an Instagram post) said she wanted to explore her sexuality. Hulu

 They eventually tied the knot at 21 and 22, but after some time, Bri wanted to explore her sexuality.
 Following “a million conversations,” Bri and Billy decided to open up their relationship to other partners. 
 The couple — who have seemingly relocated from New Jersey to California — didn’t have plans to form “an actual relationship” with someone else, but Bri says they “just kind of fell into it” with Ovard.
 10 
 Bri revealed in a TikTok that she and Billy “just kind of fell into it” with Ovard after opening up their relationship to other partners. (Pictured above: Bri, Ovard, Ferris and Billy.) Instagram/aspynovard 
 10 
 Bri and Billy will appear in “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County” alongside Ovard. Disney 
 In June, Ovard shed more light on their unorthodox dynamic in a Q&A video uploaded to her YouTube page.
 “I see so many comments that are like, ‘Oh, you’re dating a married couple?'” she said. “Technically, that’s not wrong to say, but that is not what’s in my brain. It’s just like, these are my partners. None of us feel like we’re dating.”
 “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County” premieres Thursday, Nov. 12 on Hulu.
